title: Genshin Impact — Character Story
tts_note: Genshin ALWAYS uses Chatterbox via fal-ai/chatterbox/text-to-speech. Voice refs at assets/genshin-impact/characters/{slug}/voice-1.mp3. Long monologue (>80 words) → mandatory chunking into ≤35-word segments (see sound.md §1b).

format_overrides.note: Format-level additions applied from EP9 (2026-06-29) onwards. Scenarist must implement these in storyboard.json.
format_overrides.hook_requirement: Clip 1 MUST visualize the most tragic or emotionally intense trial of the character — not a neutral opener. Visual should be scroll-stopping (dramatic contrast of light/dark, child alone, devastating loss). TTS fragment sets the stakes immediately.

promo_clip.tts_template_en: Grab free Primogems from the link in bio. Now — here's my story.
promo_clip.tts_template_ru: Забери бесплатные примагемы по ссылке в био. А вот моя история.
promo_clip.visual_note: Character faces camera in neutral/warm environment (Wangsheng gates, shrine entrance, etc). Slight knowing smile or direct gaze — as if speaking to the viewer. NOT dramatic — brief and natural, then cuts to story.

format_overrides.structure: HOOK (clip 1) → PROMO (clip 2) → ORIGIN (clips 3-4) → TURNING POINT (clips 5-6) → REVELATION (clip 7) → CTA

character_rotation.selection_note: Pick characters with strong lore arcs and tragic backstories. Prioritize 5-star characters with high popularity. Alternate male/female for variety. Avoid repeating characters used in dual-style within 4 episodes.
